{{Quote|We'll be back on ''Fett''{{'s}} trail once this job is done, I promise, but Luke needed you for this mission.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Drone Alone" />}}
Shortly after the [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|Duel on Cloud City]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] mounted a '''mission''' to steal [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|Luke, we've got a ''rat infestation'', of the ''Imperial kind''. It's a trap! They must've been waiting for us.''"<br />"''I'm on my way. Stay out of trouble until I get there.''"<br />"''That's easy for you to say&hellip;|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Drone Alone" />}}
[[File:RaptorSquad-DroneAlone.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Raptor Squad]] infiltrates [[drone vessel 171]]]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[drone freighter]]s was en route to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] with a cargo of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] learned of this convoy, the Alliance mounted a daring mission to intercept [[Drone vessel 171|one]] of those [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />
